packageRules.description: Shared workflows are consumed by major tag (RELEASE_CONTRACT.md): track major tags only, never pin to a digest.

Non-major updates (minor, patch, digest, pin) are reviewed once a week, Monday morning, in the ecosystem groups below (INFRA-143). Majors have no schedule. Security fixes ignore it: Renovate's vulnerabilityAlerts default sets schedule [] and is forced over every rule. The org's own packages stay immediate: cloud-infra's release bumps of app images, shared workflow refs. A dashboard tick (approval or Awaiting Schedule) creates the branch at once.

GitHub Actions non-major and digest updates in one PR. Actions and reusable workflows only: a version input such as setup-terraform's terraform_version stays in its own group (cloud-infra's terraform monorepo).
Docker non-major and digest updates in one PR. Org images are not grouped here: cloud-infra groups its app image bumps per environment.
Terraform provider non-major updates in one PR, across stacks.
